title: Task Mistress
description:
Hello, Sluts!
Ready to be productive? Ready to edge and edge your little mind away as you focus on whatever task that needs doing? Are you ready to abandon all resistance, listen, follow, and obey?
This session is multi-faceted and requires a more in-depth explanation. First, there are three files:
Induction Starter (10m):This is how you begin the day. It takes you down into trance and preps your mind for the upcoming productivity loop.
Productivity Loop (30m): This is what you’ll be looping for however long you need to be productive for. It has 25 minutes of productivity and then 5 minutes of edging. It’s both both nice and very mean. I praise you and insult you. I tell you how good a job you’re doing and I tell you how much of a useless bitch you are. It’s very efficient in getting you to focus on your tasks. That, I can promise you.
Rewarding Finale(10m): After you’ve done everything you wanted to, this is the closeout session which gives youmoreedging and a nice send-off.
So what you do is listen to the induction to prep your mind, listen to the loop however many times you need as you go on about your tasks, and then end it with the finale.
There is a lot of edging, so be prepared! And I’m not always all that nice!
Have fun, my productive whores!
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
RAW: usually just a plain recording, with no effects whatsoever, except for when binaurals are specified.
SFX: with sound effects, like echoes, panning, 3D, environmental effects, and all sorts of fun stuff.
Some files have many versions you can chooses from, while others are more sparse.
